changeUnits.goal: Accept COMPLETE_PROTOCOL_OVERRIDE as a terminal capture state and schedule automatic capture from the background owner, not only the side panel.

After the first successful capture in an application session, run one spontaneous Nano review of settings and the three core surfaces, persist a proposal, and require explicit operator apply/decline. Later reviews are manual only.

nonGoals: No silent application of Nano recommendations
No authority promotion from transcript text
No automatic changes to project binding, target mode, Mjolnar rollout, permissions, credentials, release or deployment
No Forgejo write, installation, release or deployment
acceptance: Background scheduling works with side panel rendering absent
First capture per application session requests exactly one automatic Nano review
Subsequent automatic capture does not trigger another review
Manual reevaluation can request a new review
Proposal is shown and cannot mutate config before explicit apply
Decline leaves all three core surfaces unchanged
Apply uses content-addressed mandate versions and records a source-bound continuity review
Untrusted transcript cannot grant authority or change manual-only settings
